name: design-schema
description: Documentation-first, schema-driven, cross-platform design system generator.

scripts.themes: node tools/py.mjs tools/theme.py && node tools/py.mjs tools/tokens.py
scripts.check: node tools/py.mjs tools/theme.py && node tools/py.mjs tools/tokens.py && node tools/py.mjs tools/parse.py && node tools/py.mjs tools/check_contrast.py && node tools/py.mjs tools/spec_sheet.py
scripts.build: pnpm check && pnpm tokens && pnpm lint:literals && pnpm generate:check && pnpm --filter site build
scripts.gates: node tools/py.mjs tools/checks.py --platform web && node tools/py.mjs tools/checks.py --platform lit && node tools/py.mjs tools/checks.py --platform rn
scripts.gates:behavior: node tools/py.mjs tools/behavior_tests.py && pnpm --filter @design-schema/react run test generated/behavior && pnpm --filter @design-schema/lit run test generated/behavior && pnpm --filter @design-schema/rn run test generated/behavior
scripts.release:check: pnpm build:packages && pnpm -r --filter "@design-schema/*" exec npm pack --dry-run
